title: Three Switches, One Bulb
summary: Use a second clue (heat) when the obvious one (light) is not available.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Three switches are outside a closed room. One controls a bulb inside.
You may enter the room only once. How do you find the right switch?
points: Three switches are outside a closed room. One controls a bulb inside.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: You cannot see the bulb from outside.
But a bulb gives out something besides light.
points: You cannot see the bulb from outside.

steps.title: The method: Use another sense
sentences: A bulb that is on also gets hot.
Switch 1 on for a few minutes, then off.
Then switch 2 on, and go into the room.
points: A bulb that is on also gets hot.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: If the bulb is on, switch 2 is the one.
If it is off but warm, switch 1 is the one.
If it is off and cold, switch 3 is the one.
points: If the bulb is on, switch 2 is the one.

quiz.q: Which clue tells us a bulb was recently on?
quiz.why: A recently lit bulb is warm.
